Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render

Class EnvironmentBackgroundRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.EnvironmentBackgroundRenderer
public final class EnvironmentBackgroundRenderer extends Object
Draws the LDR equirectangular Environment background for the Standard domain.

The renderer borrows its EnvironmentState, source PImage, and Processing-managed Texture. Production spherical capture is implemented independently by SphericalEnvironmentNativePass. The spherical methods retained here are compatibility shims only and delegate to that native pass.

    • renderCubemapFace

      public boolean renderCubemapFace(processing.opengl.PGraphicsOpenGL target, processing.opengl.PGL pgl, CubemapFace face, Quaternion sphericalOrientation)
      Compatibility entry point for spherical Environment rendering.

      Production CubemapRenderer does not use this path. The method is retained to preserve the established public surface and delegates to the same fully native spherical pass used by the production cubemap pipeline.

      Parameters:
      target - active Processing target
      pgl - already-active PGL context
      face - canonical cubemap face
      sphericalOrientation - spherical orientation quaternion
      Returns:
      true when the background was drawn

    • renderStandard

      public boolean renderStandard(processing.opengl.PGraphicsOpenGL target)
      Draws the Standard environment on a sky sphere centred on the current camera.

      The sphere is placed in camera space just inside the active far plane. Its directions are converted back to world space through the current inverse camera basis, so the panorama responds naturally to rotation while remaining centred on the eye without parallax.

      Parameters:
      target - active Standard target whose scene drawing has been flushed
      Returns:
      true when the pass was drawn
